expected.subject: Rachel, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Rachel,

Thanks for requesting a demo of Legora — I wanted to make sure you got the right introduction.

Firms like Goodwin are already using Legora to cut contract review time by around 60%, and it sounds like you may be exploring something similar.

If useful, grab a 25-minute walkthrough here: [CALENDLY_LINK].

William
Legora

notes: SMB+ (1200 lawyers) US-based firm. Demo request = hottest trigger, so keep it short, respectful, direct CTA.
